purpose: Public-safe arithmetic reproduction from inspected historical aggregate records; no final-agent gameplay or training reproduction.
source_access: Original records are not redistributed. source-records labels below are sanitized relative archival labels, not files shipped with this capsule. SHA256 identifies the inspected source bytes but does not establish an externally authenticated chain of custody.

baseline.scope: Historical rule/search baseline versus cross-deck control. First/second rows are disjoint strata of these same 400 games, not additional experiments. Seat losses are derived as games minus wins; zero draws follows from the overall zero-draw count.

ismcts_same.scope: Historical ISMCTS candidate versus frozen same-deck baseline; 400 games, balanced seats. Candidate-specific result, not a claim about all ISMCTS.

ismcts_cross.scope: Historical ISMCTS cross-deck battery; separate opponent condition from the same-deck experiment.

gumbel_same.scope: Historical Gumbel candidate versus frozen same-deck baseline. Source RNG is seeded_gumbel_noise_unpaired_official_engine_shuffle. This capsule makes no paired treatment-effect inference.

brier.scope: Historical validation class-frequency constant predictor; 17392 decision rows clustered in 185 games. Rates are published to six decimals. This is multiclass sum Brier loss, not a counterfactual action-value result.

engine.scope: Incremental optimization versus preceding implementation, exact-build macOS arm64 workload. Fifteen rotating timing batches per arm, twenty games each. Outcome/full-sequence parity is a separate fifty-game check. Additional 2x target failed; no Linux or GPU acceleration result.

rollout.scope: Historical instrumentation smoke: completed episodes and legal decisions. No completed training, convergence, strategic strength or universal correctness claim.

limitations: Wilson intervals are nominal binomial intervals for individual recorded samples, not uncertainty over all opponents or dependence-adjusted treatment effects.
The capsule contains aggregate values and does not recreate games, training, engine behavior, archived binaries or the full evaluation environment.
No raw replays, model weights, engine code, personal identities, credentials or account/remote state are included.
